- Monica — can you draft a brief CS handoff plan we can reference in the comms?
- Vivek/Evelyn — confirm if Marcus can be proposed as interim Head of Serving Platform (we discussed this tentatively).
- Aditya — we need 3 sales-facing bullet points explaining why this helps customers (renewals / SLAs / latency guarantees).

Proposed timeline: internal leadership review this week -> all-hands announcement after QBR (target 2026-03-18) -> gradual team-level reassignments over 4 weeks.
